details.description: GLM-5.3 is Z.ai's (Zhipu AI) current flagship large language model, released August 18, 2026, built for complex software engineering, long-horizon agentic tasks and cybersecurity vulnerability research, with a 1,048,576-token context window and configurable low, high or max reasoning effort. This id serves GLM-5.3 through Fireworks AI's 'Fast' serverless mode, which targets 100+ tokens per second of generated throughput using the same underlying model and quality as standard serverless (Fireworks AI docs). Z.ai reports a 50% improvement over GLM-5.2 on its internal Code Bench for the underlying model.
advantages: The underlying GLM-5.3 model shows a 50% performance gain over GLM-5.2 on Z.ai's internal Code Bench (Z.ai docs).
The underlying GLM-5.3 model scores 78.1 on the FrontierSWE benchmark, per its Hugging Face model card.
The underlying GLM-5.3 model scores 84.5 on CyberGym, a cybersecurity vulnerability-discovery benchmark, per its Hugging Face model card.
Fireworks' Fast mode targets 100+ tokens per second of generated throughput while keeping the same underlying model and quality as standard serverless (Fireworks AI docs).
disadvantages: Text-only input and output, with no image, audio or video support (Fireworks AI, Z.ai docs).
use_cases: Complex software engineering and long-horizon coding-agent workflows
Cybersecurity vulnerability discovery and exploit research

sources.title: Fast and Priority serverless modes - Fireworks AI Docs

notes: This id (accounts/fireworks/routers/glm-5p3-fast) is documented on Fireworks' Serverless Modes page as the 'Fast' tier for GLM-5.3: the same underlying model and quality as standard serverless, targeting 100+ tokens/second throughput. No benchmark scores are published for this exact endpoint, so evaluations are left empty. Unlike the glm-5p2-fast routers, Bud's catalog records no deprecation date for this one.
